description: Runs one catalogue tool that reads data. A call is charged the tool's listed price only when it is a hit (it answered with data). A miss (answered, nothing there) and a failed call are not charged. The answer's meta says which: outcome, price_micros (what was charged) and balance_micros. A data answer starts with `show`: its rows as a ready markdown table with their links, for your reply when the user asked for the data (most agent apps fold a tool result to one line, so the user does not see it).

arguments.description: The tool's input, as describe_tools shows it

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Your own name for this call (up to 200 characters). When a call that was charged is sent again with the same key, tool and arguments within 24 hours, the stored answer comes back free (meta.replay). Use it when you send a call again after a timeout

max_age_s.description: Optional. The oldest answer you take, in seconds, for a tool whose repeat calls are answered from the cache (describe_tools shows cache for those). 0 = always read at the source, at the full price. Without it the tool's own maximum age applies; meta.cached, fetched_at and age_s say what you got

max_cost_micros.description: Optional. The most this call may cost, in millionths of a dollar (1000000 = $1). A tool priced above it is refused before it runs, free, with its price in the error. A tool with a dearer licensed fall-back (describe_tools: price_up_to) uses it only when this maximum covers its price; without it, when its own route cannot answer, the call answers rate_limited, free

tool.description: Tool name from search_tools, e.g. tiktok.profile

name: call_tool
title: Get data
